title: Horizontal Positioning Fixture Hydraulic Requirements
scope_statement: Validated scope: generic hydraulic component classes, functional valve behavior, and direct port-to-port connectivity only. Pump/cylinder/reservoir sizing, pressure and flow ratings, line selection, filtration, cooling, prime mover selection, simulation and fabrication approval are explicitly deferred to the later sizing and engineering phases.
design_narrative: Open-circuit fixed-displacement hydraulic topology for a horizontal carriage with operator-commanded modes only. Tank supplies pump suction; pump pressure branches directly to the main relief valve and to the spring-centered 4/3 tandem-center DCV. Relief and DCV tank ports return directly to the tank. DCV work ports feed independent non-compensated one-way meter-in flow controls: DCV.A through the cap-side flow control to the cap side of the dual pilot-operated check, and DCV.B through the rod-side flow control to the rod side of the dual pilot-operated check. The dual pilot-operated check is installed between the metered work lines and the cylinder ports for low-leakage bidirectional holding, with cross-pilot release behavior internal to the selected generic class. The cylinder cap port is the advance/extension side and the rod port is the return/retraction side. Carriage advance, hold, and return are mutually exclusive operator-selected DCV states, not hydraulically enforced automatic sequence steps; therefore no hydraulic sequence valve, hydraulic trigger, position valve, or pressure-switch phase-change component is part of this topology.

selected_components.name: Tank
selected_components.role: Open-circuit reservoir boundary for pump suction and hydraulic returns.
configuration: S supplies pump suction.
R receives DCV return and relief discharge.
selected_components.selection_basis: Required reservoir boundary for the open hydraulic circuit.

selected_components.name: Pump
selected_components.role: Provide positive-displacement hydraulic supply for carriage motion.
configuration: Drive and displacement are deferred to sizing.
Flow capacity is deferred to sizing for the specified advance and return speeds.
selected_components.selection_basis: Smallest conventional supply class; no standby-flow reduction or energy-efficiency requirement is stated.

selected_components.name: Relief Valve
selected_components.role: Limit system pressure by diverting pump pressure flow to tank at the relief setting.
configuration: Select/set not above the 100 bar maximum system pressure requirement; exact setting and tolerance are sizing-phase items.
selected_components.selection_basis: Required overpressure protection for fixed-displacement pump outlet, actuator stall, and blocked-flow conditions.

selected_components.name: One-Way Speed Control
selected_components.role: Non-compensated meter-in speed control for carriage advance.
configuration: Port A faces DCV.A.
Port B faces the cap-side valve-side port of the dual pilot check.
A to B flow is metered for cap-end supply during extension.
B to A free reverse flow permits cap-end exhaust during retraction.
selected_components.selection_basis: Matches the typed non-compensated meter-in cap-chamber advance decision.

selected_components.name: One-Way Speed Control
selected_components.role: Non-compensated meter-in speed control for carriage return.
configuration: Port A faces DCV.B.
Port B faces the rod-side valve-side port of the dual pilot check.
A to B flow is metered for rod-end supply during retraction.
B to A free reverse flow permits rod-end exhaust during extension.
selected_components.selection_basis: Matches the typed non-compensated meter-in rod-chamber return decision.

selected_components.name: Dual Pilot-Operated Check Valve
selected_components.role: Bidirectional low-leakage cylinder holding with cross-pilot release during commanded motion.
configuration: A1 connects to cap-side metered work line; A2 connects to Cylinder.Cap.
B1 connects to rod-side metered work line; B2 connects to Cylinder.Rod.
Pressure at B1 releases A2 to A1 reverse flow during return.
Pressure at A1 releases B2 to B1 reverse flow during advance.
In neutral, reverse flow from both cylinder chambers is blocked by pilot-check behavior.
selected_components.selection_basis: Satisfies normal commanded stop-and-hold at any position without relying on DCV spool leakage performance.

selected_components.name: Double-Acting Cylinder
selected_components.role: Single horizontal carriage actuator; extension is advance and retraction is return.
configuration: Cap port is the advance/extend side.
Rod port is the return/retract side.
Stroke, bore, and rod dimensions are deferred to sizing.
selected_components.selection_basis: Required single bidirectional linear actuator for the positioning fixture.

selected_components.name: 4/3 Solenoid DCV, Tandem Center
selected_components.role: Operator-commanded extend, neutral, and retract directional control with spring-centered safe neutral.
configuration: Extend state: P to A and B to T for carriage advance.
Neutral safe state on command release: P to T with A and B blocked.
Retract state: P to B and A to T for carriage return.
Advance, neutral/hold, and return are mutually exclusive operator-selected valve states.
This DCV is not a sequence device; no hydraulic sequence step or hydraulic trigger is selected.
selected_components.selection_basis: Provides extend, retract, and safe neutral behavior while avoiding simultaneous opposing motion and unloading the fixed pump in neutral.

connections.notes: Pump outlet branches directly to the relief inlet for pressure limiting.
Pump outlet branches directly to the DCV pressure port.
Relief discharge returns directly to reservoir.
DCV tank port returns directly to reservoir.
Cap-side meter-in path; controlled A-to-B flow supplies the cap side during extension.
Metered cap-side outlet feeds dual pilot-check cap valve-side port.
Dual pilot-check cap actuator-side port connects directly to cylinder cap port.
Rod-side meter-in path; controlled A-to-B flow supplies the rod side during retraction.
Metered rod-side outlet feeds dual pilot-check rod valve-side port.
Dual pilot-check rod actuator-side port connects directly to cylinder rod port.

motion_control_decisions.justification: Horizontal resistive advance load; no load-independent speed requirement stated, so basic meter-in speed control is sufficient as a requirement-level motion-control decision.
Static holding at any commanded stop point is required; no dynamic overrunning load control is indicated for the horizontal fixture.
Horizontal resistive return load; no load-independent speed requirement stated, so basic meter-in speed control is sufficient as a requirement-level motion-control decision.

component_states.reason: Operator advance command selects the DCV extend state: P-A and B-T.

phase_configurations.notes: Advance is an operator-selected mode, not an automatic hydraulic sequence step. Supply path is Pump.P -> DCV.P -> DCV.A -> CapMeterInFlowControl.A-B metered direction -> DualPilotCheck.A1-A2 -> Cylinder.Cap. Rod exhaust is released by pressure at A1 and returns from Cylinder.Rod -> DualPilotCheck.B2-B1 -> RodMeterInFlowControl.B-A free reverse -> DCV.B -> DCV.T -> Tank.R. Return command is not simultaneous.

component_states.reason: Command release or operator hold selects tandem-center neutral: P-T with A and B blocked.

phase_configurations.notes: Hold is an operator-selected command-release/neutral condition, not a hydraulically triggered sequence step. Neutral unloads pump flow through DCV P-T while work ports are blocked. The dual pilot-operated check blocks reverse flow from both cylinder chambers for low-leakage holding.

component_states.reason: Operator return command selects the DCV retract state: P-B and A-T.

phase_configurations.notes: Return is an operator-selected mode, not an automatic hydraulic sequence step. Supply path is Pump.P -> DCV.P -> DCV.B -> RodMeterInFlowControl.A-B metered direction -> DualPilotCheck.B1-B2 -> Cylinder.Rod. Cap exhaust is released by pressure at B1 and returns from Cylinder.Cap -> DualPilotCheck.A2-A1 -> CapMeterInFlowControl.B-A free reverse -> DCV.A -> DCV.T -> Tank.R. Advance command is not simultaneous.

repair_history.rationale: Replace the DCV planning record with an explicitly non-sequencing operator-commanded 4/3 tandem-center DCV record; no hydraulic sequence trigger is required because no hydraulically enforced sequence is selected.

function_implementations.how_requirements_met: The double-acting cylinder extends for carriage advance and retracts for carriage return. Stroke, bore, and rod sizing are deferred to sizing.

Operator advance selects extend, command release or hold selects neutral, and operator return selects retract. These are mutually exclusive operator-selected valve states rather than hydraulically triggered sequence steps.

CapMeterInFlowControl meters supply flow from DCV.A to the cap-side pilot-check valve-side port during extension, matching the typed cap-chamber meter-in advance decision. Its internal free reverse path permits cap-end exhaust during retraction.

RodMeterInFlowControl meters supply flow from DCV.B to the rod-side pilot-check valve-side port during retraction, matching the typed rod-chamber meter-in return decision. Its internal free reverse path permits rod-end exhaust during extension.

function_implementations.circuit_pattern: Dual pilot-operated check holding at cylinder work lines.
function_implementations.how_requirements_met: DualPilotCheck blocks reverse flow from both cylinder chambers in neutral and releases the exhausting side by opposite-line pressure during commanded motion, satisfying normal stop-and-hold at any position without relying on DCV leakage performance.
ReliefValve connects from pump pressure to Tank.R when relieving, creating a relief path to reservoir so the pressure setting can be selected not above the 100 bar maximum during sizing.
Tank.S supplies Pump.S, and Pump.P provides the positive-displacement pressure supply for the relief branch and the DCV branch.

function_implementations.circuit_pattern: No hydraulic sequence component; operator-commanded modes only.
function_implementations.how_requirements_met: No sequence valve, pressure trigger, position trigger, or automatic hydraulic phase-change component is selected. Advance, hold, and return are implemented only by explicit DCV states selected by operator command or command release.

function_implementations.circuit_pattern: Integrated carriage-positioning topology with open power unit, main relief-to-tank pressure limiting, spring-centered 4/3 tandem-center DCV, independent meter-in speed controls, dual pilot-check holding, and double-acting cylinder.
function_implementations.how_requirements_met: The combined topology supplies pressure and flow, limits pressure to tank when required, directs extension/retraction/neutral, meters cap-side supply during advance and rod-side supply during return, and holds the cylinder at commanded stops using the dual pilot-operated check.

design_decisions.decision: Use a 4/3 spring-centered tandem-center DCV for extend, retract, and safe neutral.
design_decisions.rationale: The selected DCV has extend, neutral, and retract states. Tandem-center neutral unloads pump flow to tank while blocking A and B, satisfying operator-commanded advance/return and safe neutral on command release.

design_decisions.decision: Treat advance, hold, and return as mutually exclusive operator-commanded DCV states, not hydraulically enforced sequence steps.
design_decisions.rationale: The repair resolves the undefined hydraulic sequence trigger issue by selecting no sequence, position, or pressure-triggered phase-change valve. The DCV is only the operator-commanded mode selector; no hydraulic trigger is required because no automatic hydraulic sequence is implemented.

design_decisions.decision: Use two non-compensated one-way flow controls as meter-in controls, one on each work-line supply path.
design_decisions.rationale: The typed advance and return decisions require non-compensated meter-in control. The cap-side flow control meters supply to the cap chamber during extension, and the rod-side flow control meters supply to the rod chamber during retraction; each selected valve provides free reverse flow for the opposite stroke.

design_decisions.decision: Use a dual pilot-operated check valve between the metered work lines and cylinder ports for bidirectional holding.
design_decisions.rationale: The hold-at-any-position requirement should not rely solely on DCV work-port blocking because spool valves can leak. The integrated dual pilot check provides low-leakage cylinder-line holding in neutral and cross-pilot release during commanded extension or retraction.

design_decisions.decision: Use a fixed-displacement open-circuit pump supply with main relief protection.
design_decisions.rationale: No variable-pump, standby-flow reduction, or energy-efficiency requirement is stated. A fixed-displacement pump supplies the DCV, and the relief valve connected from pump pressure to tank protects against stalled or deadheaded conditions and supports the 100 bar pressure limit requirement.

assumptions: The carriage load is horizontal/resistive as reflected in the selected motion-control decisions, so meter-in speed control is acceptable.
DualPilotCheck cross-pilot release is internal to the selected generic class; no separate external pilot ports are listed or connected.
Solenoid command wiring and pump drive hardware are outside the hydraulic topology and are not represented as external interfaces.
The tandem-center DCV catalog key includes the required center behavior; no separate center-condition component is needed.
Advance, hold, and return are operator-commanded modes; no automatic hydraulic phase transition is required.
open_issues: Sizing must select cylinder dimensions, pump flow, and flow-control settings for 300 mm stroke, specified speeds, loads, and maximum pressure.
Relief setting and tolerance must be resolved during sizing so system pressure does not exceed 100 bar.
Power-loss holding, hose-burst retention, hold duration, and quantified drift tolerance are not specified; this topology addresses normal commanded safe-neutral holding.
Filtration, cooling, gauges, reservoir accessories, motor drive, couplings, and hoses are not represented in this topology because they are not selected components in the plan.
Sequence step 2 is hydraulically enforced but has no hydraulic trigger.

research_coverage.summary: The evidence is strong for the main fixed-pump relief-to-tank pressure limiting concept, the 4/3 spring-centered DCV and double-acting cylinder directional-control pattern, meter-in inlet flow-control placement for extend/retract under resistive loads, and leak-resistant holding using pilot-operated checks/counterbalance principles rather than relying on spool blocking. However, two critical topology decisions remain incomplete: the power unit lacks cited guidance for the reservoir-to-pump suction side and filtration/return-reservoir details, and the carriage motion-profile need lacks evidence for multi-speed regulation and automatic phase-transition logic beyond simple extend/retract meter-in speed controls.

items.rationale: Covered for fixed-displacement pump outlet feeding the circuit, main relief valve connected from high-pressure pump outlet/system pressure side to tank, return flow to reservoir, and stall/deadhead relief behavior, with textbook/technical citations. Not fully covered because the accumulated finding itself states that suction strainer/filter conventions and return-filter placement were not substantiated, and there is little cited connection guidance for the reservoir-to-pump suction path needed for a complete power-unit topology.

The findings provide cited component and connection guidance for a double-acting cylinder controlled by a spring-centered 3-position 4-way DCV, with A-to-cap/B-to-rod hookup, extend/retract command behavior, and neutral-center implications. The evidence also identifies tandem center as suitable for blocking actuator ports while unloading the pump, with a cited warning that separate load-holding may be required.

Covered for meter-in speed-control placement on cap-end supply during extension and rod-end supply during retraction, including one-way/check-bypass flow controls and the resistive-load limitation. Missing critical evidence for the requested multi-speed regulation and automatic phase-transition pattern: no cited topology for switching between speeds within a stroke, bypassing/adding flow controls, cam/limit/sequence/pressure-actuated transition valves, or automatic transition from advance to hold/return phases.

The findings provide cited guidance that blocked DCV centers alone should not be relied on for positive holding because of leakage/creep, and that pilot-operated check valves in cylinder lines are appropriate for positively locking a horizontally mounted cylinder against external forces. They also distinguish counterbalance valves for vertical/overrunning loads. This is sufficient for the stated load-holding topology, assuming the carriage is horizontal/resistive as used in the evidence rationale.

The operator stop-and-hold requirement is supported by spring-centered neutral DCV evidence plus leak-resistant load-holding evidence using pilot-operated check valves at/in the cylinder lines. The evidence also cautions that spool neutral leakage can cause creep, so the holding function should come from positive load-holding valves rather than the DCV alone.

The findings cite that fixed-volume pump circuits require relief protection, especially at actuator stall/deadhead, and that a relief valve opens at its set pressure and diverts excess flow to tank. The topology implication of setting/selecting the main relief valve not above the specified 100 bar limit is adequately supported for circuit design, although detailed margin/adjustment practice is not covered.

missing_or_weak_information: Exact missing claim for system_power_and_relief: cited power-unit guidance that the reservoir supplies the pump inlet through an appropriate suction line/strainer arrangement, and where return-line filtration, suction filtration/strainers, breather/filler, and reservoir connections should be placed in an open hydraulic circuit.

Exact missing claim for function_position_carriage_motion_profile: cited circuit pattern for multi-speed cylinder motion, such as rapid/slow advance or independently selected speeds, including which valves bypass or insert flow controls and how the circuit automatically transitions between phases using limit/cam valves, solenoid logic, sequence valves, pressure switches, or equivalent supported methods.

Noncritical limitation: existing relief evidence supports the topology and 100 bar setpoint concept but does not provide detailed design-margin, tolerance, or certification rules for relief-valve setting.

Noncritical limitation: existing holding evidence does not establish hose-burst retention or power-loss safety as explicit requirements; those would need separate validation if required by the machine risk assessment.

design_review.summary: The proposed topology functionally satisfies the brief: it provides open-circuit supply with a direct pump-pressure relief-to-tank path, a spring-centered 4/3 tandem-center DCV for mutually exclusive extend/neutral/retract operator modes, independent non-compensated meter-in controls on the cap and rod supply paths, and dual pilot-operated check holding at the cylinder ports for normal command-release stop-and-hold. Advance and return directed paths are complete, exhaust paths are released by cross-pilot action, and no automatic sequence or hydraulic phase trigger is required by the brief.
